slides.h1: Two People, Same Sun Sign, Opposite Careers
slides.sub: If Sun sign alone decided outcomes, this couldn't happen — and it happens constantly.

slides.body: Both are Virgo Sun. One is a stable, senior operator. The other has restarted careers three times. Same sign, same generic horoscope.
A single-placement reading can't see any of this. It has one input. A synthesis engine has four, cross-checked against each other.
When Rasi (birth chart) and Navamsa (D-9) disagree, the right move isn't averaging them — it's understanding which life area each one governs.

slides.h2: Try it on your own chart
slides.body: See your D-10 career signature for free — no generic template.
